## Learning goals

- I can explain how a design choice can include or exclude people.
- I can decide whether an image is informative, functional, complex, or decorative.
- I can write alt text that communicates what the image contributes.

::: {.callout-note}
This lesson applies the [BBC guidance for visually and hearing impaired audiences](https://www.bbc.com/editorialguidelines/guidance/visually-and-hearing-impaired-audiences) and the current [W3C image decision tree](https://www.w3.org/WAI/tutorials/images/decision-tree/).
:::
